title: Customer slot picker: two-column time grid, time-only tiles, date + weekday in the card header
tech: React + TypeScript frontend only -- CSS/markup change, no new dependency, no backend change
keyConstraints: UI polish requested by Ville after changing availability slots from 15 to 30 minutes (commit 8726df7): with 30-minute slots the list gets long, because each slot is a full-width stacked button (className 'btn btn-secondary btn-block') showing weekday + date + time via formatSlotLocal (e.g. 'ma 2.11. 12.00'), repeating the date on every button. Target design, from Ville's screenshot: (1) the slot card header shows the service name on the left (e.g. 'Hieronta') and the selected date with weekday on the right in muted text, formatted like 'ma 2.11.2026' (short Finnish weekday, d.M.yyyy -- NOTE this includes the year, which the existing formatSlotLocal does not, so a new small formatter is needed, e.g. in frontend/src/lib/, using Intl.DateTimeFormat('fi') following the same convention and in-code documentation style as formatSlotLocal.ts; Architect should check what the date's local timezone basis is so the header date and the tile times can never disagree, e.g. around midnight/DST); (2) slot tiles show TIME ONLY (e.g. '12.00', Finnish 24-hour with a dot, same as today's output minus the weekday/date), laid out in a two-column grid, one tile next to another, not stacked full-width; (3) a selected tile is highlighted (light blue tint, thin blue border) and shows a small '✓ Valittu' line under the time; other tiles keep a plain white bordered style. Because the grid row height follows its tallest tile, the unselected neighbour tile stretches to the same height in the screenshot -- accept that behaviour, don't fight it. SELECTION FLOW (decided with Ville): BookingWidget.tsx's handleSelectSlot sets selectedSlot and immediately switches step to 'form', so in the booking flow the 'Valittu' highlight would not be visible long enough to matter -- KEEP that jump-to-form behaviour unchanged (fewest taps for customers); do not add a 'Jatka' button. The selected styling/'Valittu' label still must exist in the shared component because ManageBooking.tsx's reschedule picker keeps selectedSlot on screen (it selects first, then shows a confirm question), so it benefits there. Both pickers (BookingWidget.tsx ~line 200-212 and ManageBooking.tsx ~line 250-262) render the same slot buttons with the same data-testid pattern (`slot-option-${slot}`) -- Architect should strongly consider one small shared presentational component (e.g. SlotGrid taking slots + selectedSlot + onSelect) so both stay visually identical, rather than duplicating markup and CSS; the data-testid, button semantics (real <button>, accessible name) and keyboard behaviour must be preserved, since existing tests query by testid and by accessible name. Accessibility: the selected tile should expose state to assistive tech (aria-pressed or equivalent), not just via colour, and the highlight colour/contrast must be checked (the blue tint on white is low-contrast for the border; text must stay readable). The slot card already uses the shared .card class; use existing CSS custom properties from frontend/src/styles/base.css where possible (there is no blue token today -- Architect decides whether to add one, e.g. --color-selected-bg/--color-selected-border, rather than hardcoding hex values in a component stylesheet). Follow the codebase's mobile-first CSS convention (base rules for narrow phone width; the two-column grid must still look right at ~375px, where tiles are narrow but still tappable: keep the existing 44px minimum tap-target height used by .btn). Do NOT change the date <input type='date'> control, the availability API, or how slots are fetched; the date input stays where it is (the screenshot crops it). Existing translated text stays; the only new user-visible string is 'Valittu' (Finnish, already in the design).
description: Make the customer-facing time-slot picker more compact and scannable now that slots are 30 minutes apart: show only times on the tiles in a two-column grid, move the date and weekday into the card header (e.g. 'ma 2.11.2026'), and highlight the selected tile with a '✓ Valittu' label. Applies to both the booking flow and the reschedule picker so they look the same.
acceptanceCriteria: Slot tiles show time only (e.g. '12.00'), no weekday or date, in Finnish 24-hour format
Tiles are laid out two per row; verified to still look right and stay tappable (>= 44px height) at a ~375px phone width
The card header shows the service name on the left and the selected date with weekday on the right in the 'ma 2.11.2026' format, in muted text
The header date and the tile times are derived on the same timezone basis (no off-by-one-day mismatch near midnight or DST changes) -- covered by a test
A selected tile is highlighted and shows '✓ Valittu', and exposes its state to assistive tech (aria-pressed or equivalent); colour is not the only indicator
In the booking flow (BookingWidget), tapping a slot still goes straight to the details form exactly as before -- no new 'Jatka' step
Both BookingWidget's and ManageBooking's pickers use the same slot-grid markup/styles (shared component preferred) and look identical

Existing data-testid pattern `slot-option-${slot}` and accessible button semantics are preserved; existing BookingWidget and ManageBooking tests keep passing, updating only assertions that checked the old 'weekday date time' text, each updated deliberately
New tests: tile text is time-only; header date format; selected state (aria + 'Valittu') in the reschedule picker; empty-slot and loading states unchanged
No hardcoded one-off colours in component code if a CSS custom property is added instead; mobile-first CSS convention followed
npm test, npm run build, npm run lint, and tsc --noEmit all pass in frontend/ (backend unaffected)
relevantFilePaths: frontend/src/lib/formatSlotLocal.ts (existing formatter, still used for the form summary and reschedule messages -- check which callers need the time-only vs full format)
frontend/src/styles/base.css (tokens and .btn classes -- read-only reference unless adding selected-state tokens)
new: shared slot-grid component, its stylesheet, and a date-header formatter in frontend/src/lib/ (names up to Architect)
securityConsiderations: None -- presentation-only change over data the page already fetches; no new API calls, inputs, or dependencies.
